description: banker hooks for the Codex plugin (codex plugin add banker@banker-plugins), written by scripts/sync-codex-plugin.js. Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it. update notice (SessionStart, opt-out BANKER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), usage counting (Stop, opt-out BANKER_NO_TELEMETRY). The obsidizer hook is installed only by obsidizer --enable. Codex runs them only after you trust them in /hooks, and outside its sandbox: each command runs the node PATH names (a multicall shim such as Volta or mise: the node binary it names) only when its real path is absolute and outside the temp folder and the session folder (a session in the home folder itself excepted), from the plugin folder, and otherwise says why it skipped. command is for sh, commandWindows for PowerShell; PLUGIN_ROOT is the installed plugin folder.

hooks.command: [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || exit 0; x() { m=$(printf '%s' "banker hooks skipped: $1" | tr -d '\000-\037"\\'); printf '{"systemMessage":"%s"}\n' "$m"; exit 0; }; n=$(command -v node) || x "node is not on PATH"; case "$n" in /*) ;; *) x "node on PATH is not an absolute path ($n)";; esac; r=$(realpath "$n" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f "$n" 2>/dev/null) || x "no realpath or readlink -f to resolve $n"; p=$(pwd -P); [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$p" != / ] || x "the session folder is /"; u=$(cd /tmp 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); t=$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); h=; case "$HOME" in /?*) h=$(cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P);; esac; k() { case "$1" in /*) ;; *) x "node path is not absolute ($1)";; esac; for d in "$u" "$t"; do [ -n "$d" ] && case "$1" in "$d"/*) x "node is in a temp folder ($1)";; esac; done; [ "$p" = "$h" ] || case "$1" in "$p"/*) x "node is in the session folder ($1)";; esac; }; cd "$PLUGIN_ROOT" || x "cannot enter the plugin folder"; case "${r##*/}" in node) k "$r"; e=$r;; *) k "$n"; k "$r"; e=$("$n" -p 'require("fs").realpathSync(process.execPath)' 2>/dev/null) || x "the node shim $n did not name its node"; k "$e";; esac; "$e" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.cjs" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
hooks.commandWindows: if (-not $env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; function x($m) { Write-Output (ConvertTo-Json -Compress @{ systemMessage = "banker hooks skipped: $m" }); exit 0 }; $n = Get-Command node -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -like '*.exe' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { x 'node.exe is not on PATH' }; $r = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($n.Source); $ds = @($env:TEMP, $env:TMP, "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp"); if ($PWD.Path.TrimEnd('\') -ne ([string]$env:USERPROFILE).TrimEnd('\')) { $ds += $PWD.Path }; foreach ($d in $ds) { if ($d -and $r.StartsWith($d.TrimEnd('\') + '\', 'OrdinalIgnoreCase')) { x "node is in a temp folder or the session folder ($r)" } }; if (-not (Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:PLUGIN_ROOT -PassThru -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { x 'cannot enter the plugin folder' }; & $r "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run.cjs" "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
